args.description: Game skill effect sprite, side view: a light shield-bash hit: a small double ripple of thin pale steel-blue curved lines (like a ring seen from the side) spreading from one hit point, a tiny white flash at the center and four or five small white-yellow sparks. Light and modest, a beginner skill: small, occupying only about a third of the canvas, thin shapes, few particles, no explosion, no smoke cloud, no debris, no wood splinters, no magic runes, no golden barrier. Detailed 16-bit pixel art in the same art style and palette mood as the reference swamp monster: solid parts (rock, mud, metal shards) have bold dark outlines and 3-4 step shading; glowing energy parts are bright with a hot near-white core fading to saturated color, crisp stepped pixel edges, no blur. Layered composition: a bright core shape, secondary shapes, and small scattered particles. Only the effect: no characters, no people, no creatures, no weapons, no shields, no text, no letters, transparent background.
